ios.desc:
Graft Count - Hair Transplant
Discover if your hair transplant was successful with advanced AI technology. Our app analyses your scalp, counts grafts, and scores your hair transplant.

Key Features:  
- Graft Count & Success Score – Instantly estimate grafts and rate your hair transplant’s success.  
- Personalised Recommendations – Get tailored tips based on your transplant stage.  
- Free Evaluation – Try our AI analysis free.
- Secure & Private – Your data stays safe and confidential.
- Export Detailed PDF Report

Who Is This App For?  
- Individuals post-hair transplant seeking to track progress and estimate graft counts for personal reference—consult a doctor for medical advice.
- Anyone curious if their transplant looks natural or successful—our AI provides honest, unbiased feedback.

How It Works:  
1. Take a photo of your scalp (not your face!).  
2. Our AI instantly analyses grafts, visual look, and success—free to get evaluation.

Get the insights you need to feel confident about your hair restoration. Try Hair Transplant AI Success today and see your transplant’s true potential!

DISCLAIMER:
“This app is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making any medical decisions or relying on the app’s insights.”

quotes.text:
I don't know what you think but I don't trust most of the hair transplant clinics.
They will charge you per graft transplanted but you will typically have no proof. Just a trust based system. Because they said so.
I wanted to change that quickly and efficiently. Now, using simple computer vision techniques and with help of latest AI models, It gets easier. With this mobile app(ios only for now), you can get graft count estimation, a hair transplant analysis with a success score, recommendations and suggestions. It is time to verify what you have been told in those clinics.
